about: The MAA's Putnam competition for US and Canadian undergraduates: 12 proof problems in two 3-hour sessions (A and B) on the first Saturday of December; papers and solutions from Kiran Kedlaya's Putnam Archive (solutions are Kedlaya et al.'s, not MAA official).
